summary.text: Wayne Fontana is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania State Senate, representing District 42 since June 14, 2005, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is a real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Wayne Fontana earned an associate degree from the Community College of Allegheny County in 1971, and his professional experience includes working as a real estate broker.
Before becoming a state senator he served on the Allegheny County Council from 2000 to 2005 and as a ward committee member for the Allegheny County Democratic Party from 1994 to 2006.
For 2025 and 2026 Fontana was assigned to the Law and Justice, Community, Economic and Recreational Development, Finance, and Urban Affairs and Housing committees.
Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate in the District 42 general election.
